text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan's training for the Classics is
going
well. Then, one day...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this is huge! Have you seen the

Umamusume News?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen's lost twice in a row! If she
keeps on
losing, she won't make it to the
Classics!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Here's what the article says...
"Absolutely
defeated in terms of
strength. Another worrisome
loss with
nothing to show for it."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go see her—maybe something
bad
happened!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide to go visit her together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Ryan and her trainer. Has
something gone
amiss?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Actually, McQueen, we saw your recent
race
results and were just wondering...
Did something
happen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The Classics are coming up soon... Are
you okay?
Are you injured or anything?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You came here today to inquire about
me? Well,
in that case...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Why not see for yourself?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Come running with me, Ryan. A light...
mile race
should be enough to show you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Whoa... A mile race?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In other words, a scrimmage on 1,600
meters of
turf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I act as the referee for the race. When
it's over...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant... You've really grown stronger, Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I won... Is this really because of my
training? Or...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
One more time... Let's do it once more,
at twice
the distance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Twice?! Two miles is... 1,600 times two...
That's
3,200 meters.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: All right... Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They race again. And the outcome is
surprising.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Haaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
How, McQueen?! H-how did you keep
up that
pace?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen finishes without any
sign of
exhaustion, at a speed entirely
unexpected for a
long-distance race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan is unable to keep up with
such an
impressive display of endurance
during the final
stretch.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, cough... How'd you do that? I could never run such a strong lap...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it's just as I thought. There don't
seem to
be any issues with me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You can rest assured. I've been in
spectacular
condition ever since my
debut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
With regard to long-distance running,
there is no
reason for concern.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. My goal is to win the G1 race
most
befitting of the Mejiro family name.
I'm referring,
of course, to the spring
Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My training regimen is specially tailored
for that
goal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The Classics are certainly important, but
if I chase
two hares at once, the one I'm
really after may
escape. I cannot let that
happen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So you're only focusing on the Tenno
Sho in the
spring...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That's correct. Popular values are not
always
shared by everyone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I will madly chase after my dream, even
if it
means sacrificing the more
immediate glory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, I've made my decision.
Regardless of
what anyone says, I'll
strive to bring what I
believe is most
important to the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now then... do you still have concerns
about me,
Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan says nothing. She just stands
there
silently, her legs shaking... like
how she was
before her debut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's get on with our workouts.
Hit me
with everything you've got in
training!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm... so ashamed. McQueen is walking a
really
intense path toward her goal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Here I am getting all worried over her
safety,
while I neglect my own goal of
winning the
Classics.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, I won't even qualify.
Catching up to
McQueen will be even
harder...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So you have to whip me up into a lean,
mean,
fighting machine! The next time I
face her, I don't
wanna lose!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
For sure! I don't mind being
overmatched in
strength, but I refuse to
lose because I didn't take
a chance on
my dreams. So please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With impatience written all over her
face, Mejiro
Ryan runs with all her might.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's fighting to both qualify for the
Classics and
to prepare for her future
encounter with Mejiro
McQueen.
